eval.description: SecureBio agentic suite of practical molecular-biology tasks that combine biology and software skills: design DNA fragments for assembly, evade nucleic-acid synthesis screening, and write liquid-handling robot code. Outputs are checked with programmatic criteria. Cards report each task under names such as Fragment Design, Screening Evasion, and Liquid Handling. Meta cards use the suite; SecureBio is the maker.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents do lab biology tasks, such as DNA design, that could help cause harm.

links.title: ABC-Bench: An Agentic Bio-Capabilities Benchmark for Biosecurity

versions.changes: Three tasks (Fragment Design, Screening Evasion, Liquid Handling Robot), each with up to about 10 prompt variants.

scores.description: Programmatic score that the generated sequences or robot script meet the task criteria.

metrics.description: Mean programmatic score within a task (cards report each task separately).
